name: Gareth Llewellyn
bio:
Gareth's motorsport journey began not on the track, but in the pits. He started as a junior mechanic, fueled by a deep-seated fascination with the engineering intricacies of racing machines. His sharp eye for detail and strategic mind quickly propelled him through the ranks, leading him to management roles within smaller racing teams before catching the eye of AF Corse.

As a sporting director, Gareth is known for his meticulous planning and data-driven approach. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels valued and empowered. Gareth's distinctiveness lies in his ability to balance technical expertise with strong interpersonal skills, ensuring both optimal performance and a positive team dynamic. He is also committed to nurturing young talent within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a receding hairline
physical.description: Gareth is a man of medium build, with a weathered face that speaks of years spent under the pressure of the racing circuit.

quirks: Always carries a well-worn notebook filled with handwritten race notes.
Insists on a pre-race cup of strong Welsh tea, brewed exactly the same way every time.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought, often driving colleagues slightly mad.
